description.value: Car people, truckers, transportation afficionados, air-pirates, they are the sole carriers of product across the world, maintaining the transport and supply chains in the time of the Red.
Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

The very sight of the Militech Crusher is enough to bring a tear to any gun lover's eye. This powerful shotgun, designed for short-range combat, was first created in the year 2020, soon becoming one of the period's most iconic weapons. The version currently available on the market has seen some updates from the original - including a new, modern sight - but its distinctive look remains the same. Once standard-issue among corporate guards, today the Crusher is popular among mercs with a nostalgic streak.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Shotgun • Skill: Handgun • Range: Short Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: None

Range: Short Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost: 250eb (Expensive) ♦ Required Slots: 0

Fits: All weapons capable of firing Slugs and/or Shells

You don't need special sights, rifling, or smartlinks to ensure a target drops — you need a bigger tube to fire your slugs and buckshot out of.

Attaching this attachment requires a DV17 Weaponstech Skill Check. Only one Shotgun Rechamber may be installed. Once installed, this attachment can not be uninstalled. When installed, the weapon's Single Shot and Shotgun Shell damage is increased by 1d6, to a maximum of 5d6 in either mode (Unless its base damage is higher, in which case that takes over and is not increased). Unless installed in cyberware, the weapon must now be wielded in two hands to fire, even if it was previously a one-handed weapon.

Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Change the weapon's damage by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Internal Components).
Light version of an Armorjack for your head. No armor penalty.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
A cybernetical replacement leg. Comes with a free foot.

The modern Kerenzikov takes the place of the now defunct Reflex Co-Processor to help reduce the strain on the user's Neuroport.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
A common CHOOH2-powered roadbike seen during the time of the Red.

Can be applied to all vehicles. Adds two Hidden Holsters to the vehicle, and a large hidden compartment for smuggling purposes. These can be discovered with a DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object check.

Can be taken multiple times with the exception of Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters.
